comparison: The same native app/model using ordinary tools and ordinary tools plus fr, twice per task.
publication: User approved patches and summary only. Full logs, prompts, exports, source archives and execution packets stay local.

local_checker_versions.objcopy:
llvm-objcopy, compatible with GNU objcopy
LLVM (http://llvm.org/):
  LLVM version 22.1.8-rust-1.98.1-stable
  Optimized build.

accounting: CLI-reported categories retain client meanings. Unknown account charges and incomplete usage are not replaced with zero.
cache_state: Fresh conversations and projects. Operating-system and provider caches are uncontrolled.
resource_scope: Elapsed time covers the complete controller attempt. CPU and RSS samples describe the native CLI process group. The outer workstation guard also covers controller preparation and capture.

jobs.name: Real fr changes, refusals and checked delivery
Execute every example in the current fr skill
Check the updated authoring rule with Lean
Check all three native clients with both tool setups
Reject incomplete changes in private containers

shared_setup.scope: Shared preparation is outside per-attempt timers. Unknown setup costs remain unknown. No live warm-up calls.
